D7 accession vote

D8 accession vote

S3 ON and OFF
OFF = D1/D4/D6. ON = D2/D3/D7. ON mean omits D7 only for discordant models.
The maintained-treatment label is the locked grouping. D7 harvest-time exposure is not established. ON–OFF is observational and confounded with model/study.
S3 direct D5 effect
Mean of H3 maintained vs drug-free resistant and P3 maintained vs withdrawn NES. Positive means higher during maintained drug exposure.
robust_D5 is the frozen robust_shared_exposure_candidate flag: concordant H3/P3, significant both, P3 direction and significance retained in replicate-exclusion sensitivity.
S3 complete separation
D7 models must agree. For positive ON–OFF delta, minimum of all three ON values exceeds maximum OFF; for negative delta, maximum ON is below minimum OFF.
This strict D7-aware criterion follows the recovered conversation checkpoint. Historical script 47 provides the five-category hierarchy; script 63 provides the final ON/OFF inputs.
S3 categories
Strong convergent: robust D5 + agreement + separation; convergent: robust + agreement without separation; D5-specific exposure: robust + disagreement.
Observational-only: nonrobust D5 + separation. Remaining: weak/mixed. Counts 0/9/9/2/30; Spearman rho −0.2557022809123649; sign agreement 24/50.
Missing values
NA means no defined descriptive D7 accession NES because the two models disagree. It is not zero.
Direction 0 is an explicit no-formal-vote code. There are no imputed missing measurements.
Statistical terminology
NES = normalized enrichment score; padj = source BH-adjusted enrichment P value; significance is strictly padj <0.05.
Per-pathway summaries do not represent a new pooled effect estimate, combined P value, or meta-analysis model.
